layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Figure 1. EasyOmnimatte is the first, end-to-end video omnimatte method, eliminating the need for slow, multi-stage optimization-based

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: pipelines (e.g., Gen-Omnimatte [15]). EasyOmnimatte produces high-fidelity alpha mattes that accurately capture the associated effects, all

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: within just seconds, representing a significant gain over existing state-of-the-art methods in both quality and efficiency.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Abstract

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Existing video omnimatte methods typically rely on slow,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: multi-stage, or inference-time optimization pipelines

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: that fail to fully exploit powerful generative priors,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: producing suboptimal decompositions. Our key insight

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: is that, if a video inpainting model can be finetuned

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: to remove the foreground-associated effects [15], then

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: it must be inherently capable of perceiving these effects,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and hence can also be netuned for the complementary task:

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: foreground layer decomposition with associated effects.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: However, although naïvely finetuning the inpainting model

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: with LoRA applied to all blocks can produce high-quality

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: alpha mattes, it fails to capture associated effects. Our

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: systematic analysis reveals this arises because effect-related

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: cues are primarily encoded in specific DiT blocks and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: become suppressed when LoRA is applied across all blocks.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: To address this, we introduce EasyOmnimatte, the first

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: unified, end-to-end video omnimatte method. Concretely, we

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: inetune a pretrained video inpainting diffusion model to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: learn dual complementary experts while keeping its original

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: weights intact: an Effect Expert, where LoRA is applied only

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: to effect-sensitive DiT blocks to capture the coarse structure

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of the foreground and associated effects, and a fully LoRA-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: fnetuned Quality Expert learns to refine the alpha matte.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: During sampling, Effect Expert is used for denoising at early,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: high-noise steps, while Quality Expert takes over at later,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: low-noise steps. This design eliminates the need for two

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: full diffusion passes, significantly reducing computational

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: cost without compromising output quality. Ablation studies

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: validate the effectiveness of this Dual-Expert strategy.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Experiments demonstrate that EasyOmnimatte sets a new

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: state-of-the-art for video omnimatte and enables various

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: downstream tasks, significantly outperforming baselines in

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: both quality and efficiency.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 1. Introduction

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Decomposing videos into layered representations is a funda-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mental problem in computer vision, with significant appli-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: cations in video editing and visual effects. Effective decom-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: position enables a variety of video editing tasks, including

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: object removal, background replacement, and other creative

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: workflows. However, extracting accurate alpha mattes for

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: target foregrounds is labor-intensive, especially for com-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: plex effects arising from object-environment interactions

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: such as shadows, reflections, generated smoke, or splashes.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Apparently, this task is highly difficult to achieve using con-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ventional methods. To address this, the pioneering work [27]

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: has formulated the Omnimatte task, which seeks to separate

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: a foreground object and all its associated visual effects into

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: a single coherent layer, and trains a UNet model on the input

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: video in a self-supervised manner. Subsequently, there has

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: been a surge of follow-up omnimatte methods improving it

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: from various perspectives. However, these follow-ups typi-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: cally rely on slow, multi-stage, or inference-time optimiza-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tion pipelines that fail to fully exploit powerful generative

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: priors, producing suboptimal decompositions.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: In this work, we present the irst unifed, end-to-end frame-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: work for video omnimatte generation, addressing the afore-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mentioned limitations, as illustrated in Fig.2. Our key insight

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: is that since video inpainting models can be finetuned to re-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: move foreground-associated effects [15, 45, 52, 53], they

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: must inherently perceive them. Consequently, instead of re-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: moving these effects, we can finetune the same model to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: extract them for the foreground layer prediction. To this end.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: we explore employing lightweight Low-Rank Adaptation

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: (LoRA) [10] modules to finetune the inpainting model on

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: a synthetic matting dataset, enabling it to directly predict

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the foreground layer in a single, efficient stage. Nonetheless,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: our initial experiments (in Fig.8) with this straightforward

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: setup revealed a critical and unexpected challenge: while the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: finetuned model effectively mattes the foreground objects, it

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: failed to consistently perceive and capture associated effects

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: such as shadows and reflections — even when trained with

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ground-truth targets that include them.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Intrigued by this phenomenon, we conduct a systematic

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: analysis of the model's internal mechanisms. Inspired by

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ObjectDrop [45] and the analysis in Gen-Omnimatte [15],

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: we examine how different blocks of the inpainting model

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: respond to subtle “effect" cues. Our structural analysis of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the inpainting model reveals that the perception of these

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: effects is concentrated within a specific subset of blocks

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: in the DiT architecture. Applying LoRA to all DiT blocks

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tends to overemphasize the main alpha prediction task and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Figure 2. (a) Previous two-stage approaches (e.g., Generative Om-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: nimatte [15]) suffer from costly test-time optimization and error

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: propagation. (b) In contrast, our unified framework simultaneously

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: predicts the background and separates the foreground with its ef-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: fects in a single end-to-end model.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: inadvertently suppresses the weaker, effect-related signals,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: manifested as missing effects in the omnimatting results.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: With these findings, our key idea is to finetune a pretrained

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: video inpainting diffusion model to learn two complemen-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tary experts while keeping its original weights frozen: an

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Effect Expert, where LoRA is applied only to effect-sensitive

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: intermediate stages to capture the coarse structure of the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: foreground and its associated effects, and a Quality Expert,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: where LoRA is applied to all DiT blocks, learns to add

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: fine details to the alpha matte. Notably, during diffusion

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: sampling, the Effect Expert model is only employed at early,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: high-noise stages to generate coarse, effect-aware omnimatte

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: predictions, while the Quality Expert model refines the alpha

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: matte only at later, low-noise stages. Rather than running

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the two finetuned models sequentially for full diffusion sam-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: pling, this alternating strategy achieves high-quality results

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: with roughly half the computational cost.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Experiments confirm that this classic coarse-to-fine strat-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: egy, which leverages both the specialized and full LoRA

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: adaptations, is crucial for producing alpha mattes that are

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: accurate and faithfully preserve associated effects. Our eval-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: uation demonstrates that EasyOmnimatte sets a new state-of-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the-art (SOTA) video omnimatte. Importantly, the proposed

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: method maintains an end-to-end, feed-forward decomposi-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tion of the foreground layers, ensuring both effectiveness

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and efficiency.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: In summary, our main contributions are as follows:

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: • We introduce the first end-to-end video omnimatte method,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: which directly adapts a pre-trained video inpainting model

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: to capture associated visual effects, eliminating the need

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: for slow, multi-stage optimization-based pipelines.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: • We perform a structural analysis revealing that the standard

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: inpainting pretraining objective inherently conflicts with

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the preservation of foreground effects, strongly motivating

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: our key designs.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: • We finetune a pretrained video inpainting diffusion model

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: to learn two specialized experts. These complementary

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: experts operate in tandem across the high- and low-noise

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: denoising stages, producing high-fidelity alpha mattes that

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: accurately capture the associated effects, all without addi-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 2. Related Work

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Foreground Isolation and Matting. The most straightfor-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ward way to extract the foreground layer from a video is

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: via matting [31, 40]. Converting the foreground into a trans-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: parent (RGBA) format enables a wide range of video edit-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ing tasks, making video matting a fundamental technique

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: for such applications. In recent years, deep learning-based

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: matting methods for both images [11, 44, 46, 49, 51] and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: videos [12, 21, 37, 47] have achieved significant improve-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ments, enhancing the accuracy of alpha matte prediction

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: while reducing the need for extensive guidance informa-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tion. These methods, often trained on fine-grained labeled

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: datasets, can automatically learn image features to predict

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: high-quality alpha mattes. However, limitations in the di-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: versity of training data [20, 32, 37, 46] and specific train-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ing strategies [12, 13, 21] often limit their performance to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: certain foreground categories, most notably humans. Fur-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: thermore, they tend to fail to capture foreground-associated

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: effects, such as shadows or reflections. While some methods

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: [20, 35] leverage a known background to partially address

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: these limitations, they impose strict requirements, such as a

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: static scene or a pre-captured clean background plate.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Video Matting with Associated Effects. A series of meth-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ods, exemplified by Omnimatte [26, 27], enables the decom-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: position of a video into foreground and background layers,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: with the foreground layer encompassing associated visual

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: effects. These approaches aim to completely separate the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: foreground layer from the video, leveraging motion cues

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: through flow-based techniques [1, 3, 41] to achieve this

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: effect. Subsequent works have further enhanced the capabili-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ties of Omnimatte by incorporating deep image priors [7, 28]

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: extending planar homography constraints through non-rigid

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: warping [26, 50] or 3D scene representations [19, 36]. How-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ever, a significant drawback is the reliance on restrictive

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: motion assumptions, which can result in severely degraded

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: performance when such assumptions no longer hold.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Video Inpainting for Object Removal. Both background

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: matting and Omnimatte-like optimization methods rely on

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: precise background guidance. On the other end, the rapid

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: progress of visual generative models [2, 5, 6, 8, 9, 14,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 24, 38, 48] has greatly advanced video inpainting tech-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: niques, enabling accurate background layer prediction. Early

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: video inpainting methods focused on natural content com-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: pletion by exploiting spatio-temporal cues from adjacent

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: frames [4, 23, 39, 56] or propagating optical flow [17, 54]

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: to reduce hallucinations and artifacts within masked regions.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: The latest approaches [16, 57] directly adapt and fine-tune

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: large video generative models for efficient object removal.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Nonetheless, these methods cannot eliminate the associated

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: effects of an object, often leaving residual artifacts inside

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the inpainted background. In image object removal, several

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: recent methods [45, 52, 53] have specifically addressed the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: challenge of removing both objects and their associated ef-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: fects. The key idea behind these approaches is to condition

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the generative model on the original, unmasked image, en-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: abling it to learn the correlations between objects and their

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: corresponding effects. Building on this success, Generative

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Omnimatte [15] (referred to as Gen-Omnimatte) extends

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: this idea to video generation models, successfully training a

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: video removal model capable of cleanly removing objects

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and their associated visual effects. Its success has also in-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: spired training-free research approaches like [34].

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 3.1. Repurpose Inpainting Diffusion for Omnimatte

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Video inpainting models inherently encode a strong separa-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tion prior, allowing them to remove foregrounds and their

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: associated effects [15]. We leverage this prior differently: by

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.text: 4.1. Comparison with State-of-the-Art Methods

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Optimization-based Omnimatte Prediction. After gener-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ating the background with the same removal model we use

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: we employ the Omnimatte Optimization method from Gen-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Omnimatte [15] to decompose the foreground. Following the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: official recommendations, we set the number of optimization

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: steps to 4000 and enabled detail transfer [26]. Note that this

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: is a test-time optimization method similar to the previous

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: approaches [19, 27], requiring several minutes of optimiza-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tion for each foreground layer, which is over an order of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: magnitude slower than our approach.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Learning-based Matting Prediction. We establish two

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: categories of learning-based matting baselines. First, for

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: background-matting methods, we use the output of our

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: removal model to guide BGMv2 [20]. Second, for mask-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: guided methods, we generate an initial mask for the fore-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ground and its effects by integrating the segmentation

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: model [33] with SSIS-v2 [43]. This mask is then used to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: prompt the video matting model [47] for prediction. While

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: contemporary learning-based methods are considerably more

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: efficient than Gen-Omnimatte, they typically fail to preserve

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the object's associated effects, and even with auxiliary post-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: processing, the results are often suboptimal.

layout_dets.text: 5. Conclusion

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: We introduce EasyOmnimatte, a novel, end-to-end frame-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: work for video omnimatte, that is capable of capturing com-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: plex foreground-associated effects with ease. Our key idea is

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: to repurpose a powerful video inpainting model that has been

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: proofed to be capable of perceiving the associated effects.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Nonetheless, a trivial setup that directly apply LoRA to all

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: DiT blocks fails to capture the effects. We analyze the source

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of this failure and, consequently, propose the Dual Expert

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: matting strategy. This strategy successfully captures the asso-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ciated effects while simultaneously producing high-quality

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: alpha matting. Our work establishes a new and highly effec-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tive paradigm for adapting large-scale generative models to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: complex, detailed video decomposition tasks.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Limitations and Future Work. While our method demon-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: strates superior omnimatte performance, it is intrinsically

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: linked to the capabilities of the base inpainting model. For

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: future work, we will implement our block-wise analysis and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: adaptation framework to diverse generative models.
